figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Conceptual radiologist-anatomy analogy and source-rotation motivation. It is not a reader study, measured diagnostic benefit or validated reproduction of human reasoning.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Encoder/view-predictor/EMA architecture, target affinities, masked-token learning and domain classifier. Yaw/pitch/roll labels are schematic; default yaw and the separate three-axis ablation are resolved from methods/results.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All rows and five benchmark columns plus reported averages inspected in supplied text and visual notes. X-WIN Base/Large averages are 0.883/0.892; no displayed uncertainty. Data modality, supervision and backbone differ among comparators.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All five models and 4-shot/8-shot/16-shot/all-data columns checked. X-WIN 0.993 is all-data. Ark+ leads at four shots. Five-run means have no dispersion.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Four t-SNE panels showing representation grouping before and after few-shot fine-tuning. Embedding axes are not physical coordinates or clinical time; no quantitative calibration or clinical reliability follows.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Loss-weight and angular-step ablations using VinDr linear-probe AUROC. No exact curve values were estimated from plot positions. No error bars or horizon-drift test are reported.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Step-wise yaw, direct yaw and direct yaw-pitch-roll compared through VinDr/CheXpert AUROC. This is a training-design comparison, not L3 matched intervention-response validation.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Centroid cosine similarity 0.845→0.967 and L2 distance 3.973→1.825 with domain loss. Cohort counts and uncertainty are absent from the table; no clinical sim-to-real outcome agreement is measured.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Two qualitative simulated-query/real-target examples with left ventricle, right hilum and aortic arch similarity maps. No localization error, numeric color scale or cohort-wide success metric.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: All four codebook configurations and usage/projection/CT fidelity columns checked. Best reported configuration is 1024×256. Larger codebooks do not uniformly improve results.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 6
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Axial/coronal/sagittal reconstructions from ground-truth versus rendered projections. Blur and local-detail loss are acknowledged. The ground-truth-projection reconstruction is not explicitly the original CT.

All 11 physical pages of supplied PDF text were read. The current pass had supplied page-image review notes, not direct access to the original page images; upstream visual-review claims are preserved with that provenance.
The PDF path, availability, page count and SHA-256 are supplied source-record metadata. No local file was opened or hashed in this response.
The page-image notes were produced in three partial-page batches. Their statements that other pages were unavailable are batch-local, not evidence that pages are missing from the combined input.
The supplied 11-page version ends with references. Training, additional fine-tuning and reconstruction appendices are mentioned but not included; no separate supplement was available.
No schema validator, semantic checker, repository access, code execution, filesystem write or graph rebuild was executed in this response.
The implemented transition changes acquisition view around fixed anatomy. No longitudinal disease progression, treatment-response dynamics or learned patient-time evolution is demonstrated.
L2 is supported by the separately trained decoder/rendering experiment using specified geometric actions; downstream classification scores alone do not establish successor-state prediction.
Multiple projections for tomography are not a reported L3 matched alternative-action decision comparison. No planner/policy or L4 decision/control result is reported.
A retained context representation supports angle-conditioned queries, but recursive state persistence, posterior belief filtering and observation re-assimilation are not established.
The default action is scalar yaw. Pitch/roll occur in an evaluated alternative training design and in schematic coordinates; they must not be silently assigned to the default configuration.
The exact endpoint convention underlying the reported angular candidate counts is not specified. All reported range, step sizes and candidate counts are retained without correction.
The pretraining counts are images and CT scans, not patient counts. Rounded Table 1 counts are compatible with the exact Section 4.1 counts and are not treated as conflicting.
Patient eligibility, demographics, disease-stage distributions, downstream sample counts, contributing-site counts and complete dataset release versions are not_reported.
Complete downstream and reconstruction partitions, patient-overlap controls, pretraining/test leakage checks and separation of hyperparameter selection from final testing are not_reported.

R2 is narrowly scoped to the explicitly reported official-test representation analysis using actual VinDr CXRs. Synthetic NLST projection holdouts do not establish R2. A locked diagnostic model's non-leaky internal validation is not established by that narrow facet.
R3 is unresolved: cross-dataset transfer is reported, but independent external clinical validation with adequate overlap/adaptation controls is not established.

No actual clinician/reader evaluation, prospective shadow operation, patient intervention, comparative effectiveness or regulated deployment is reported. Radiologist analogies and annotations in cited datasets are not human evaluation of X-WIN outputs.
No prospective patient/workflow benefit, diagnostic equivalence of reconstructed CT or patient-specific CT recovery from paired actual routine CXRs is demonstrated.
The 0.993 COVIDx AUROC belongs to all-data fine-tuning, not the few-shot conditions. Ark+ exceeds X-WIN at four shots and slightly exceeds X-WIN ViT-Base on VinDr.
AUROC averages are copied as reported, not recomputed or pooled with reconstruction metrics. Headline gains have no reported confidence intervals or statistical tests in the supplied tables.

Five-seed means do not provide run-to-run uncertainty when dispersion is unreported. Stochastic target-angle selection, contrastive probabilities and codebook usage do not establish predictive uncertainty decomposition or calibration.
Table 3 measures downstream classification under different training action designs, not matched action-effect fidelity or recursive error growth.

Representation-centroid similarity and qualitative patch correspondences do not establish full distributional alignment, anatomy-preserving registration, disease preservation or matched sim-to-real outcome agreement.

Projection/CT reconstruction cohort size, input-view protocol, angle coverage, complete geometry, PSNR intensity normalization, SSIM implementation and aggregation are not_reported in the supplied version.

FDK/ASTRA contributes analytical reconstruction after learned projection decoding. Its contribution is not isolated by a displayed reconstruction baseline against alternative clinical reconstruction systems.
Figure 6 compares reconstructions from ground-truth and rendered projections; row (a) is not explicitly the original CT. Blurriness and loss of local detail are acknowledged.
Future comparisons with models trained directly on CT and additional domain-adaptation approaches are not completed experiments.
Source-rotation bounds are geometric training constraints, not validated radiation-safety limits or clinical contraindication rules.

Clinical safety guards, abstention, escalation, security testing, X-WIN-specific privacy protection, intended-use restrictions, lifecycle monitoring, ethics approval and authorization are not sufficiently reported.
The paper states a code URL; accessibility, released weights, prompts, license and reproducibility were not independently checked. Standard ViT parameter counts were not inferred.
No cited system's planning, control, causality, privacy, open-weight or regulatory capabilities are inherited into this annotation.
